'''Wampa''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] designation given to a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] that fought at the [[Second Battle of Sernpidal]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. It was destroyed by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]].
